structure: Part 3 of repo:tests (trade-imports-ins-tests on main at c433e6b): the animals end-to-end specs for the pages at the end of and around the live-animals journey. Read in full: tests/animals/e2e/pages/declaration.spec.ts (Declaration page: 4 draft tests, 1 unfinished-draft refusal, 3 looped blank-answer refusals, 2 looped draft/amendment heading tests), confirmation.spec.ts (Import notification submitted page: 4 tests on a submitted notification, 1 for a draft, 1 after an ITAHC upload, 1 after a non-ITAHC upload, 2 looped identifier-incomplete cases), notification-view-states.spec.ts (Notification view states: DRAFT 11 tests, DRAFT ready to submit 2, AMEND 3, SUBMITTED 8, 3 tests looped over submitted with and without the health certificate, and 1 not-found), notification-dashboard.spec.ts (8 tests: start and list a draft, dashboard basics, card actions by status, copy from a card), notification-dashboard-pagination.spec.ts (1 test), features/notification-dashboard-sort.spec.ts (2 tests and 4 looped per sort option) and features/notification-dashboard-search.spec.ts (7 tests). Also read in full as support: the animals declaration, confirmation, notification view, dashboard, overview, cancel amend and delete page objects; the shared view header, declaration content, GOV.UK banners, delete notification, sets, dashboard copy, summary list and base page objects; the sort-by values, notification status and fulfilments models; the notification actions and seeded journey flows; the ui fixture and the timestamped reference util. Covered: the declaration page (route, heading, legend, checkbox, Continue, date line, refusals), the confirmation page (heading, outstanding items, view-or-amend sentence, HMRC and call charges links, section headings), the notification view in draft, ready draft, amending, submitted and not-found states (heading, status tags, titles, dates, header buttons and their styles, import reference numbers, numbered sections, cards, change links, end controls, refusal), the animals notification list (heading, start button, summary cards and rows, status tags, card actions, result count wording, 25-a-page pagination, sort options and default, reference search and how it survives sort and paging), and the gaps the page objects show but no test drives. Since the 26 November extract the contact address section, card and error link have gone from these specs, and the overview Review and submit tests have left notification-view-states.spec.ts, so the claims that rested on them are replaced or dropped.

claims.statement: A notification is held as a reference number, a list of fulfilments by obligation, an optional list of submitted fulfilments, a status, a created date and an optional submitted date.
claims.note: The submitted fulfilments are what the service compares an amendment against; nothing here records an outstanding-items list.

claims.statement: An amendment is started by posting to /live-animals/notifications/<reference>/amend, which redirects to that notification's view.
A new notification is created by posting to /live-animals/notifications, which redirects to the new notification's origin page and so fixes its reference number.
claims.quote: export const CREATE_PATH = `${SET_BASES.liveAnimals}/notifications`;  /  throw new Error(`POST ${CREATE_PATH} redirected to "${location}", which is not a new notification's origin page.`);

claims.statement: Every page of a notification carries an optional return marker and an optional trail of the places the trader came by, which the suite ignores when it asks which page is open.

claims.statement: Each test annotates the notification references it created, so a run reports which notifications it left behind.
